about: Built by tools/build-atlas-eras.py from tools/atlas-realms.json: the realms outside the American keyframes, each unit an OpenHistoricalMap relation drawn between its own dates (decimal years, BCE negative). Do not edit by hand.
source: OpenHistoricalMap contributors (CC0 1.0), many boundary ways from IGN/CNIG municipal limits (CC BY 4.0); coast: Natural Earth 1:50m (public domain)

text.en: OpenHistoricalMap has no shape for Baetica before 14 BCE.
text.es: OpenHistoricalMap no tiene forma para la Bética antes del 14 a. C.

text.en: No sourced border exists for the taifas, the Almoravids or the Almohads, so the Muslim south of the peninsula is left blank from 1031 to 1232.
text.es: No hay fronteras con fuentes para las taifas, los almorávides ni los almohades, así que el sur musulmán de la península queda en blanco de 1031 a 1232.

text.en: OpenHistoricalMap has no shape for the Kingdom of Portugal between 1199 and 1297, so none is drawn.
text.es: OpenHistoricalMap no tiene forma para el reino de Portugal entre 1199 y 1297, así que no se dibuja.
